commit_math.interpretation: Scheduler explicitly promotes sample to FP32, forms dt from two indexed scalar sigmas, computes dt*BF16 model_output, adds sample, and casts back to model_output dtype. Zero-dimensional floating coefficient does not force the dimensioned BF16 multiplicand to FP32; the observed low-precision multiplication agrees with BF16 coefficient and product rounding. CPU arithmetic check corroborates scalar-versus-length-one promotion but is not CUDA replay.
commit_math.scope: Posthoc saved-operand arithmetic for two native final commits. Not presealed Z4 prediction, independent readout prediction, universal scheduler arithmetic, or proof that final-output equality uniquely identifies every internal operation. Per-token timesteps, stochastic sampling, tensor coefficient dimensionality, dtype, kernel/backend or source changes can alter the expression.
